remarks: Prime Downtown Stamford - Spacious 2BR, 2BA Corner Apartment with Expansive Private Patio. Step into a newly upgraded residence radiating elegance! Upon entry, floor-to-ceiling windows fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The open layout combines the living and dining areas, flowing effortlessly into a kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, granite countertops, and premium stainless steel appliances. Newer hardwood floors add a touch of timeless style to a modern design. A standout feature, the oversized 33x11 private patio, ideal setting for entertaining guests this summer. The generous primary suite boasts crown molding, a walk-in closet, and an en-suite bath with refined finishes. Keep your bills low all year round with an ultra-quiet Fujitsu ductless Energy Star rated heating/cooling system. Washer/Dryer in unit. Dedicated garage parking and plenty of guest spaces. On-floor fitness center. Live-in superintendent for convenient assistance. Outdoor community terrace with grilling stations. Just a 5-minute drive to Metro North and the downtown area.
